description: When a Guest selects 'not attending' in the RSVP Form, the plus-one menu/controls hide. The form currently shows the plus-one controls regardless of the attendance selection. Scope is the RSVP Form UI state.
title: Not-attending RSVP hides the plus-one controls
acceptance_criteria: Selecting 'not attending' hides the plus-one menu/controls in the RSVP Form
Switching back to 'attending' restores the plus-one controls
A not-attending submission carries no plus-one data
